clips.title: The story
paras: Roetten Stonehammer works from the Library in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. He represents Reclaimers Inc., organizing expeditions and hiring adventurers for salvage work in distant lands such as Desolace.

In the Hall of Explorers' Library, Roetten Stonehammer handles practical recovery for Reclaimers Inc. He connects mercenaries with salvage work across Kalimdor. His associates seek valuable cargo, wreckage, and rare reagents in dangerous lands such as Desolace.
